findings: History's "Scan bracelet" box does not search on a paste: in all four pastes the code sat in the box and Find had to be pressed. SCRUM-790's commit (1cba0361d) says the paste-to-load change covers History, but it only changed apps/pos/src/components/fnb/ScanWristband.tsx, which History does not use (History.tsx has its own Bracelet code input). The order loaded on Find every time.

The History list on screen did not show the new charge Z797-000002 until History was left and opened again (the open list is not re-read after an Add time payment). The order's own Time added card showed it at once.
The option amounts read ฿900 / ฿1800 / ฿2700 and "Amount to charge ฿1800" without a thousands comma; the sum line reads ฿1,800 with one (the lane kept the dialog's existing baht() style on purpose).

The sale detail returns print jobs with kind and status only, so the receipt's printed text ("3 Extra hour x 2") was not read back; the charge's line was (label "Extra hour x 2", quantity 3, unit ฿600).
notTouched: No real till was opened or pressed (Till 1 (Pi), Till 2 (test), Reception Till 1, FWBooth1 read back unchanged); the park Pi was not used; no till notice was pressed (the "7 overdue", "4 out of stock" and "3 jobs waiting" chips were left alone); no SMS, no setting changed; cash only, no card or QR payment started; no refund made. The four sales stay recorded.
